rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: High-performance read-only MongoDB server built in Rust that enables safe database querying for both Kubernetes-deployed instances and direct URL connections. Supports comprehensive query operations including find, aggregate, countDocuments, and distinct with JSON validation and timeout handling. Features saved query templates with variable substitution, data model documentation integration, and automatic credential extraction from Kubernetes pod environment variables for streamlined cluster access.
